37862-saul-of-tarsus-a-tale-of-the-early.title: Saul Of Tarsus A Tale Of The Early Christians
37862-saul-of-tarsus-a-tale-of-the-early.creator: Unknown
37862-saul-of-tarsus-a-tale-of-the-early.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. With foot as rapid and as noiseless as that of a fox among the tombs, the Levite crossed the threshold into the great gloom of the interior. This way and that he turned his head, watchful, furtive, catching every obscure corner in the range of his glance.

arxiv-2011-03352.title: Deep learning architectures for inference of AC-OPF solutions
arxiv-2011-03352.creator: Thomas Falconer, Letif Mones
arxiv-2011-03352.description: Abstract We present a systematic comparison between neural network (NN) architectures for inference of AC-OPF solutions. Using fully connected NNs as a baseline we demonstrate the efficacy of leveraging network topology in the models by constructing abstract representations of electrical grids in the graph domain, for both convolutional and graph NNs.

arxiv-2011-10327.title: Primordial monopolium as dark matter
arxiv-2011-10327.creator: Vicente Vento
arxiv-2011-10327.description: Abstract The existence of monopoles is a characteristic signature of Kaluza-Klein multidimensional theories. The topology of these solutions is extremely interesting. The existence of a dipole solution, which we have associated to a monople-anti-monopole bound state, is the leitmotiv of this investigation.

arxiv-2109-08328.title: Cranked Skyrme–Hartree–Fock–Bogoliubov approach for a mean-field description of nuclear rotations near the drip line
arxiv-2109-08328.creator: Kenichi Yoshida
arxiv-2109-08328.description: Abstract To describe the yrast states in weakly bound nuclei, I directly solve the coordinate-space cranked Skyrme–Hartree–Fock–Bogoliubov equation on a three-dimensional lattice with the continuum states discretized in a box. After the numerical demonstration for the ground-state band in a medium-mass nucleus, I apply the newly-developed method to neutron-rich even- N N Mg isotopes.

arxiv-2210-08145.title: Self-Repetition in Abstractive Neural Summarizers
arxiv-2210-08145.creator: Nikita Salkar, Thomas Trikalinos, Byron C. Wallace, Ani Nenkova
arxiv-2210-08145.description: Abstract We provide a quantitative and qualitative analysis of self-repetition in the output of neural summarizers. We measure self-repetition as the number of n n -grams of length four or longer that appear in multiple outputs of the same system. We analyze the behavior of three popular architectures (BART, T5 and Pegasus), fine-tuned on five datasets.

arxiv-2212-05496.title: Stable unital basis, hyperfocal subalgebras and basic Morita equivalences
arxiv-2212-05496.creator: Tiberiu Coconeţ, Constantin-Cosmin Todea
arxiv-2212-05496.description: Abstract We investigate Conjecture 1.6 introduced by Barker and Gelvin in [ 3 ] , which says that any source algebra of a p p -block ( p p is a prime) of finite group has the unit group containing a basis stabilized by left and right action of the defect group.

arxiv-2310-15256.title: SimBIG : Field-level Simulation-Based Inference of Galaxy Clustering
arxiv-2310-15256.creator: Pablo Lemos ∗, Liam Parker ∗, ChangHoon Hahn, Shirley Ho, Michael Eickenberg, Jiamin Hou, Elena Massara, Chirag Modi, Azadeh Moradinezhad Dizgah, Bruno Régaldo-Saint Blancard, David Spergel
arxiv-2310-15256.description: Abstract We present the first simulation-based inference (SBI) of cosmological parameters from field-level analysis of galaxy clustering. Standard galaxy clustering analyses rely on analyzing summary statistics, such as the power spectrum, P ℓ P_{\ell} , with analytic models based on perturbation theory. Consequently, they do not fully exploit the non-linear and non-Gaussian features of the galaxy distribution.

arxiv-2405-19510.title: Significant Mutual Inclinations Between the Stellar Spin and the Orbits of Both Planets in the HAT-P-11 System
arxiv-2405-19510.creator: Qier An, Tiger Lu, G. Mirek Brandt, Timothy D. Brandt, Gongjie Li
arxiv-2405-19510.description: Abstract Planet-star obliquity and planet-planet mutual inclination encode a planetary system’s dynamical history, but both of their values are hard to measure for misaligned systems with close-in companions. HAT-P-11 is a K4 star with two known planets: a close-in, misaligned super-Neptune with a ≈ \approx 5 day orbit, and an outer super-Jupiter with a ≈ \approx 10 yr orbit.

pmc-11600792.title: Improving medication safety for intensive care patients transitioning to a hospital ward: development of a theory-informed intervention package
pmc-11600792.creator: Richard S Bourne, Mark Jeffries, Jennifer K Jennings, Darren M Ashcroft, Paul Norman
pmc-11600792.description: BackgroundCare of critically ill patients is complex, requiring effective collaboration co-ordination and communication across care teams and professions. Medicines are a fundamental component of the acute interventions intensive care unit (ICU) patients receive, requiring frequent review and optimisation according to patient needs.

pmc-11639370.title: HcGAN: Harmonic conditional generative adversarial network for efficiently generating high-quality IHC images from H&E
pmc-11639370.creator: Shuying Wu, Shiwei Xu
pmc-11639370.description: Generating high quality histopathology images like immunohistochemistry (IHC) stained images is essential for precise diagnosis and the advancement of computer-aided diagnostic (CAD) systems. Producing IHC images in laboratory is quite expensive and time consuming. Recently, some attempts have been made based on artificial intelligence techniques (particularly, deep learning) to generate IHC images.

pmc-11657424.title: Risk of Aedes-borne diseases in and around the Tanzanian seaport of Tanga despite community members being more concerned about malaria
pmc-11657424.creator: Amri S Abas, Alfred J Simfukwe, John P Masalu, Najat F Kahamba, Ismail H Nambunga, Dickson S Msaky, Alex J Limwagu, Abdallah R Kipekepeke, Carsten Wergin, Rukiyah M Njalambaha, Elison E Kemibala, Amour Seleman, Yeromin P Mlacha, Marceline Finda, Uli Beisel, Esther G Kimaro, Halfan S Ngowo, Fredros O
pmc-11657424.description: BackgroundIncreased global trade, while beneficial economically, can also increase the spread of vector-borne diseases, particularly those transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes spreading via trade routes. Given the heightened trade-induced activity at ports of entry, it is particularly crucial to assess the risk of mosquito-borne diseases in these settings.

pmc-12494532.title: Active and passive physical therapy in patients with chronic low-back pain: a level I Bayesian network meta-analysis
pmc-12494532.creator: Alice Baroncini, Nicola Maffulli, Nicola Manocchio, Michela Bossa, Calogero Foti, Luise Schäfer, Alexandra Klimuch, Filippo Migliorini
pmc-12494532.description: BackgroundChronic low back pain (cLBP) is common. Physiotherapy is frequently indicated as a non-pharmacological management of these patients. This Bayesian network meta-analysis compared active versus passive physiotherapy versus their combination in terms of pain and disability in patients with mechanical and/or aspecific cLBP.MethodsIn June 2025, the following databases were accessed: PubMed, Web of Science, Google Scholar and Embase.

pmc-12701544.title: Association Between the Creatinine-to-Body Weight Ratio and All-Cause Mortality in a Rural Japanese Community
pmc-12701544.creator: Ryuichi Kawamoto, Asuka Kikuchi, Daisuke Ninomiya, Masanori Abe, Teru Kumagi
pmc-12701544.description: BackgroundEvidence on the association between the creatinine-to-body weight (Cr/BW) ratio and the risk of all-cause mortality remains limited. In this prospective, population-based cohort study, we examined the association between baseline Cr/BW ratio and survival over 10- and 22-year follow-up periods.

pmc-12968086.title: Deterministic quantum light emitters in DNA origami–engineered molecule–MoS₂ hybrids
pmc-12968086.creator: Zhijie Li, Shen Zhao, Iuliia Melchakova, Elisabeth Erber, Christoph Sikeler, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Tim Liedl, Alexander Högele, Anvar S Baimuratov, Irina V Martynenko
pmc-12968086.description: The functionalization of atomically-thin transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) with organic molecules is a promising approach for realizing nanoscale optoelectronic devices with tailored functionalities, such as quantum light generation or p-n junctions. However, achieving precise control over the molecules’ positioning on the 2D material remains a significant challenge.

pmc-13186890.title: Inhibitory effects of three genuine resin glycosides from Calystegia hederacea on in vitro porcine lipase assay and in silico docking simulation analysis
pmc-13186890.creator: Hirotaka Nishikawa, Masashi Hirano, Hideki Kinoshita, Kazunari Yoneda, Masateru Ono, Shin Yasuda
pmc-13186890.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Resin glycosides are characteristically present in Convolvulaceae plants. We recently demonstrated that three genuine resin glycosides, muricatins V, VI, and IX, from the seeds of Ipomoea muricata, inhibit lipase. This study investigated whether the resin glycoside fraction (CHRG Fr.) obtained from the whole plants of Calystegia hederacea and three resin glycosides, calyhedins II (1), III (2), and VIII (3), from the rhizomes of this plant, can inhibit porcine lipase in vitro. The results indicated the inhibitory effects of CHRG Fr.

pmc-13243597.title: Feasibility of whole heart 3D shape reconstruction from sparse echocardiographic views using CT-derived simulations
pmc-13243597.creator: Yuan Wang, Hao Xu, Wenliang Lu
pmc-13243597.description: To verify the feasibility of reconstructing whole heart from 2D ultrasound sparse views. This study introduces a series of models for whole-heart reconstruction and conducts a benchmark study to evaluate the impact of pose information on reconstruction accuracy using synthetically generated 2D ultrasound sparse views from CT volumes, with the CT volumes serve as the label.

pmc-13273204.title: Diagnosis and management of Children with Post-Intensive Care Syndrome in Paediatrics: Clinical Practice Guidelines by the French National Authority for Health (HAS)
pmc-13273204.creator: Judith Chareyre, Marie Pouletty, Luc Morin, Mehdi Aoun Sebaiti, Julie Brosolo, Chloé Berthaud, Anne Chevé, Violaine Deneux, Lucie Eches, Caroline Genet, Karine Kolev, Antoinette Lejeune, Céline Ricignuolo, Jean-Charles Rossi, Denis Tiberghien, Delphine Micaelli, Albane Mainguy, Michael Levy, French
pmc-13273204.description: ObjectiveAdvances in paediatric intensive care have resulted in a growing population of survivors exposed to long-term morbidity. Paediatric post–intensive care syndrome (PICS-p) encompasses new or worsened physical, cognitive, psychological/psychiatric, and socio-familial impairments that may affect children and their families after discharge from the paediatric intensive care unit (PICU).

pmc-13531320.title: De Novo Lupus Anticoagulant-Positive Catastrophic Antiphospholipid Syndrome With Multiorgan Microvascular Failure: A Thrombotic Cascade Beyond Control
pmc-13531320.creator: Mohd Laraib, Anoop Tiwari, Kamal Saini, Preeti Solanki, Satish Kumar, Payal Jain
pmc-13531320.description: Catastrophic antiphospholipid syndrome (CAPS) is an uncommon but life-threatening manifestation of antiphospholipid syndrome characterized by rapidly progressive multiorgan failure due to diffuse small-vessel thrombosis. Early recognition is challenging, particularly in patients without prior obstetric morbidity or established autoimmune disease. We report a 38-year-old woman who presented with acute limb ischemia, respiratory distress, thrombocytopenia, and acute cerebral infarcts.
